options.content:
### Workload overview
GPU measurements and activity, followed by workloads, components and exporter diagnostics. Select a workload to inspect its components and Pods.

Load both rules from `recording-rules.yaml`. cAdvisor and DCGM are optional sources. Activity panels require a separate `workload_gpu_observer_*` observer, which is not supplied by DSX. Missing sources remain unavailable. Component filters apply only to component panels.
